title: Create Survival Plus
description: Create Survival Plus (CSP) blends the creativity and automation of the Create mod with a refined vanilla survival experience, enhanced by immersive realism mechanics, expanded biomes, Quark features, and More!
body:
Create Survival Plus (CSP) blends the creativity and automation of the Create mod with a refined vanilla survival experience, enhanced by immersive realism mechanics, expanded biomes, Quark features, and a carefully selected collection of quality-of-life additions.
Made by Logan
